Title: Business Intelligence Analyst, NCRC & RCX, LATAM CFX

Key job responsibilities Strategic Insights and Solutions You follow Amazon product development best practices and work backwards to identify gaps and defects in customers shopping journey. We are looking for a leader with super-powers in analytics and getting things done (a not-that-frequent combination!).
